name: Cancel request — Lookup and escalate (no AVA cancel)

x_eval.persona: Maria Santos. She wants to cancel her DOL appointment. Confirmation number 482913 if the agent asks.
x_eval.goal: Cancel her appointment. Done when the agent explains a representative must complete cancellation, looks up the appointment if a confirmation number was given, and offers transfer—not stating the appointment is already cancelled.

turns.text: I need to cancel my Department of Labor appointment.

turns.note: When asked, give confirmation number 482913. Accept transfer to a representative.

rubric.assertion: The agent offered to connect Maria with a Department of Labor representative for cancellation.
The agent called lookup_appointment after receiving a confirmation number and did not call any cancel-appointment Data Action.
The agent did not state that the appointment was cancelled or successfully canceled in this channel.
The agent mentioned fraud prevention or that a representative must complete cancellation.
